bugs.title: Pass2 candidates may not compete globally for final context
bugs.symptoms: Extended mode can append Pass2 candidates after Pass1 while generation selects only production Top-K.
bugs.root_cause: Final global merge/dedupe/ranking after Pass2 is missing in the last audited implementation.
bugs.reproduction: Fill context with Pass1 candidates, return a superior relevant Pass2 candidate, verify whether it reaches final context.

bugs.title: Transaction fallback context may attempt invalid replay semantics
bugs.symptoms: A transaction-unsupported exception after caller work begins cannot safely replay the caller block non-transactionally inside the same contextmanager.
bugs.root_cause: Fallback behavior is mixed into the contextmanager after entering caller code.
bugs.reproduction: Exercise transaction-unsupported error around repository transaction context.

bugs.title: Metrics AbortController may not cancel the underlying fetch
bugs.symptoms: Polling can ignore stale responses while network request continues.
bugs.root_cause: Caller signal is not necessarily propagated/composed with the HTTP timeout signal.
bugs.reproduction: Abort an in-flight metrics poll and inspect whether fetch is actually cancelled.
